rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for being unable to see.

example.english: I went blind when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zau6 maang4 zo2

rows.note: Use this when someone fails to perceive or recognize B, rather than when they are physically blind.

example.english: The photo is so blurry that I’m blind to who it is.
example.traditional: 張相太矇，我睇唔到係邊個。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng2 taai3 mung4 ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2 hai6 bin1 go3

rows.note: Use this for doing or choosing something on a wild guess without prior knowledge.

example.english: I was just guessing blind, but somehow I got it right.
example.traditional: 我亂估咋，點知真係中咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lyun6 gu2 zaa3 dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 zung3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when an attitude or action disregards evidence, reasons, or reality.

example.english: Don’t be blind to reality and follow trends without thinking; think it through first.
example.traditional: 唔好盲目跟風，要諗清楚先。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 maang4 muk6 gan1 fung1 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1
